name: Sources
usage: Sources under an AI answer, search results that back a reply, the documents behind a summary

props.name: items
props.description: The sources, in the order of their numbers (the first is 1).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Shows the list expanded at first.

types.name: SourceItem
types.summary: One source of Sources and Citation.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Stable key; the index is used when omitted.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the page or document.

fields.name: url
fields.description:
Address. Only http, https, mailto and relative addresses become links (others are shown as text); the site
name is taken from it.

fields.name: icon
fields.description:
An icon for the site, provided by the application (such as an image from its own server). Remote site icons
are never loaded automatically.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
The list is collapsed to "3 sources" at first; expand it to see the numbered sources with their site and a short
description.

examples.name: Expanded
examples.title: Expanded, with icons
examples.description: `defaultExpanded` shows the list at once. Site icons are never loaded automatically: pass your own in `icon`.
